# origincloud_dns_vpc_attachments (Data Source)

Lists a private zone's VPC attachments, oldest first. With `-` for the zone, lists every zone's in the project, which with `vpc` finds the zones attached to a VPC.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosted_zone` (String) The hosted zone whose vpc attachments to list.
- `project` (String) The project whose vpc attachments to list.

### Read-Only

- `vpc_attachments` (Attributes List) The vpc attachments listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc_attachments))

<a id="nestedatt--vpc_attachments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpc_attachments`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) When the zone was attached. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `name` (String) The attachment's resource name. Its last segment is the VPC's id.
- `urn` (String) The attachment's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.
- `vpc` (String) The VPC the zone answers in, in the zone's project.
